Cookie Policy

Effective Date: 1 January 2026 • Last updated: August 2026

1. Use of Cookies & Local Storage

We use strictly necessary cookies and local browser storage to remember your language preference (English / Myanmar), maintain secure authentication tokens, and preserve your route quote state.

2. Managing Preferences

You can clear your cookies or adjust browser security settings at any time without impacting basic ride booking capabilities.
